name: Lumino Industries Ltd
tagline: Kolkata-based conductors/power-cables manufacturer and T&D EPC contractor riding the grid-buildout tailwind, but a sharp post-IPO borrowings spike (reportedly ~7.8x FY26 EBITDA) and a commodity-manufacturing moat temper the story just 10 days after listing.
business_overview: Lumino Industries Ltd manufactures aluminium conductors (including HTLS/ACSS/ACFR), power cables and electrical/house wires, and also operates as an EPC contractor for power transmission and distribution projects, from a Howrah (West Bengal) manufacturing base. IPO'd on NSE+BSE (bidding Aug 27-31, 2026; listed 3-Sep-2026, BSE code 544894, NSE: LUMINO) with a ~34% listing-day pop. Seeded via X (untrusted triage, @JakeraChoudhury, high conviction bullish view).
fundamentals_table: Borrowings reportedly rose from ~Rs 384 Cr (FY26-end) to ~Rs 1,857 Cr by end-July 2026 - ~7.8x FY26 EBITDA (~Rs 239 Cr) per one press source
